I, Munasingha Kariyawasam Appuhamilage Don SomadasaGunawardana, Minister of Lands, hereby declare under Sub-section(1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands describedbelow are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under theprovisions of that Act.

Two allotments of land in total extent of about 1.1871 Hectaredepicted as Lots 'A' and 'B' in Advance Tracing No.: Ku/PNN/2014/070 of 30.04.2014 prepared by the Superintendent of Surveys -Kurunegala, situated in the Village of Kandanegedara in the GramaNiladhari Division No. 1524 of Kandanegedara in Pitigalkorale MinorDivision in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Pannala inKurunegala District of North Western Province and bounded asfollows:

01. Lot 'A' – Koongahamulahena alias Kahatagahamulahena– Extent: About 1.1442 HectareNorth: Dawatagahamulawatta claimed by D. M. Jayathilake,Kahatagahamulawatta claimed by K. R. M. Dayasena andKahatagahawatta claimed by S. A. Ratnasena; East:
